title: Mpoha and Anor v Salvator (SCZ 8 25 of 2021) [2022] ZMSC 7 (22 February 2022)
issue_tags: alleged smuggling of funds does not invalidate contract absent illegal purpose
appellate review limited to questions of law, not re‑appraisal of factual findings.
outcome_detail: Leave to appeal refused: alleged smuggling did not render the contract illegal and proposed appeal raised only factual issues
